minimum_conditions: Verify the pinned commit and root Apache-2.0 LICENSE.
Reject files with conflicting SPDX-License-Identifier headers.
Preserve per-file source path, immutable URL and SHA-256.
Keep training_eligible=false until separate human rights and quality review.
Do not count this source as sufficient by itself for the 2.5 GiB per-library threshold.

measured_upstream_inventory.note: Measured from the GitHub recursive tree at the pinned commit; workflow recomputes actual downloaded counts.
